text:
Evidence supports selecting relevant history, but does not directly establish fixed lexical recent-anchor gating. [SIM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2006.05639) retrieves historical behaviors relevant to a candidate item; its query differs from recent interactions. [Parallel Attention Network](https://arxiv.org/abs/2006.15346) models long- and short-term interests, arguing that the last interaction alone can inadequately represent recent preference. These motivate relevance selection and multiple recent anchors; neither validates TF-IDF cosine gating or the proposed multiplicative weights.

Recent-only TF-IDF pooling is the simplest temporal baseline: responsive to interest changes, but discards older relevant history. Repeated-support pooling weights historical items by agreement with other window items, favoring recurring themes without explicitly identifying current intent. Recent-anchor gating retains older items resembling recent interactions, potentially recovering returning interests. These are mechanistic hypotheses requiring validation. Crucially, exclude self-matches: with normalized TF-IDF, whole-window maximum similarity u_j equals 1 for every nonempty item vector if j can match itself. Recent-anchor items similarly receive a_j=1 when self-matching is allowed. Even after exclusion, maxima measure strongest resemblance, not how often an interest repeats.

Compare normalized pooling with weights r_j, r_j*u_j, r_j*a_j, r_j*u_j*a_j, r_j*u_j², and r_j*a_j²; include recent-only pooling. Keep lexical features, window, recency weights, scoring, and tuning budget fixed. Replace recent anchors with equally many random or oldest anchors, and shuffle timestamps while preserving items. Match attenuation using a tuned exponent u_j^p and compare effective pooling size, 1/Σw_j² after normalization. Gains over squared or concentration-matched controls suggest added selection information; gains over random/old anchors support temporal specificity. Select using the pinned four-category macro validation HR@10 and report category results without consulting test labels.
